title: Executive- Credit Vetting Analyst
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Credit Vetting Analyst to conduct credit and identity verification checks for new and existing business customers across SME, SOHO, LSME and Corporate segments. The role supports Vodafone’s credit risk framework through customer due diligence, credit assessment, credit limit management and fraud prevention.The role also supports compliance with Credit and Collections policies, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, audit obligations and regulatory standards, helping protect Vodafone from bad debt and fraud exposure.

**What you'll do**
------------------

Complete credit assessments for new business account applications and assess customer creditworthiness using available assessment data.  
Review and validate company information and legal entity details.  
Conduct credit reference agency checks using approved credit bureau tools.  
Recommend appropriate risk classifications and escalate high-risk applications to Credit Risk Management for approval.  
Review existing customer accounts where credit limits have been exceeded.  
Review and validate company registration, director and business ownership information, proof of identity and proof of address documentation where required.  
Verify directors and authorised signatories against approved identification sources and ensure KYC documentation is complete before account activation.  
Review requests for new or increased credit limits and support quarterly reviews of existing customer limits.  
Ensure credit limits remain aligned with customer risk profiles and exposure levels, with final credit limit setting approved by the Credit Risk Manager.  
Maintain complete audit trails and supporting evidence and assist with internal and external audit activities.  
Support control monitoring and remediation activities and ensure security deposit requirements and risk controls are applied consistently.

**Who you are**
---------------

Previous administration experience.  
Experience reviewing customer documentation and performing data validation.  
Experience in transactional tasks and customer due diligence.  
Experience handling confidential customer information.  
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Office applications.  
Ability to prioritise workload effectively and work within agreed service levels.  
An understanding of customer documentation, credit assessment and KYC processes relevant to the role

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

The role provides exposure to business credit assessment across SME, SOHO, LSME and Corporate customer segments, along with practical experience in customer due diligence, KYC, credit risk assessment, credit limit management, fraud prevention and audit controls

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Business credit assessment and creditworthiness evaluation.  
Customer due diligence and KYC validation.  
Credit bureau and reference-checking processes.  
Credit risk classification and escalation.  
Credit limit monitoring and review.  
Fraud and bad-debt risk awareness.  
Audit trail management and compliance controls.  
Customer documentation and data validation.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
### **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Cloud Security Engineer** to lead the design, security, automation, and operational excellence of our cloud-native healthcare platform.

This role combines **Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Security Engineering, and Healthcare Compliance** to build secure, scalable, and HIPAA-compliant systems on AWS.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Cloud & Platform Architecture**

* Design and manage scalable, secure AWS architectures.
* Build containerized and serverless platforms using **EKS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions**.
* Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Build automated security policy enforcement and compliance controls.
* Establish infrastructure governance and drift detection processes.

#### **DevSecOps & Infrastructure Automation**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using **GitHub Actions**.
* Implement **Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)**.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, testing, security, and compliance controls.
* Drive Security-as-Code and Compliance-as-Code practices.

#### **Security & Compliance**

* Design and implement security controls using: **IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Dependabot, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF**
* Manage and Secure Kubernetes RBAC, containers, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Lead **HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2,** and healthcare security compliance initiatives.
* Conduct threat modeling, risk assessments, vulnerability management, and incident response.

#### **Application & API Security**

* Establish secure development practices for **React, Node.js, Python, REST APIs, HL7 and FHIR APIs**.
* Conduct architecture reviews and secure code assessments,
* Lead threat modeling activities.
* Implement OAuth2, OpenID Connect, RBAC, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Integrate security testing into development and deployment workflows.

#### **AI & Healthcare Innovation**

* Establish security architecture for AI-enabled healthcare workflows.
* Support secure adoption of **Amazon Bedrock, RAG, AI Agents, and Healthcare AI solutions**.
* Implement Data Privacy Controls, Prompt Security, Model Access Controls, AI Governance Frameworks.
* Ensure PHI is protected within AI and GenAI workflows.

### **Required Skills**

* AWS Architecture & Security
* Terraform & CloudFormation
* Kubernetes (EKS), ECS, Docker
* GitHub Actions & CI/CD
* React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python
* PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB
* Cloud Networking & Observability
* HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST
* FHIR, HL7, Healthcare Interoperability
* Amazon Bedrock, RAG, AI Security

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8+ years in Cloud, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering.
* 5+ years designing and securing AWS production environments.
* Experience building healthcare platforms handling PHI.
* Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps.
* Experience implementing HIPAA and SOC 2 controls.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional
* AWS Security Specialty
* CISSP, CCSP, HCISPP
* Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a **Detection & Response Engineer** to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Investigate security cases and targeted hunts using CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and CQL; correlate telemetry, assess scope and impact, document findings, and recommend appropriate actions.
* Develop, test, deploy, tune, and maintain detection logic, queries, dashboards, analyst guides, and version-controlled detection content.
* Build and maintain Falcon Fusion SOAR workflows for enrichment, evidence capture, routing, escalation, and authorized response.
* Validate telemetry coverage and quality; troubleshoot parsing, normalization, mapping, and source-data issues.
* Translate validated investigations into platform workflow specifications and co-build scripts, API integrations, workflow components, and prototypes with Product and Engineering.
* Test workflows and detections against representative cases; monitor outcomes, exceptions, and production feedback, and document ownership and support handoffs.
* Provide technical support, troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and coaching; coordinate assigned analysis and platform work.

**Must have:**

* 5+ years of relevant security experience, including at least 2 years developing, testing, and tuning detection logic, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
* Production proficiency with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, including CQL, cross-source investigations, detection content, telemetry interpretation, and tuning.
* Hands-on Falcon Fusion SOAR workflow experience and practical use of Charlotte AI with evidence verification and awareness of approval boundaries.
* Practical Python, REST/Falcon APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and secure credential management; familiarity with PowerShell or another relevant scripting language.
* Experience with telemetry onboarding, parser/normalization troubleshooting, MITRE ATT&CK, Windows/Linux events, and controlled changes, version control, peer review, and regression testing.
* Strong investigation judgment, defensible documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience converting SOC runbooks or manual analysis into production workflows or internal security platforms.
* CrowdStrike resident, responder, partner implementation, or customer-embedded Falcon experience; FalconPy or comparable API tooling.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering on analyst-facing features, case lifecycle integration, acceptance testing, or iterative delivery.
* Managed security services, multi-client or follow-the-sun SOC operations, and ITSM integrations such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Relevant CrowdStrike training or credentials, GIAC invest
